svg.title: Speculative decoding: an EAGLE-3 head guesses tokens and a big model checks them in one pass
svg.text: Speculative Decoding, One Verify Pass at a Time
An EAGLE-3 head reads Qwen3-1.7B's hidden states and guesses up to 8 tokens, as many as it's sure of. Qwen3-1.7B checks them in one pass and keeps them up to the first miss.
Prompt: Rewrite the text below as the first three sentences of a news article headlined "Ggml v1.0.0". Begin with who or what the news...

g.text: Qwen3-1.7B alone, on the same clock
tokens gained per pass of the big model
The same text, 100 tokens from 45 big-model passes and 1.56 times as fast with guesses once the prompt is read. Every pass was timed on 2 CPU cores, and it plays at real speed.
